page.overview:
What is Forced Evolutionary Virus?

Forced Evolutionary Virus belongs to Fallout. The Forced Evolutionary Virus, typically shortened to FEV, is an artificial virus created by the pre-War West Tek's NBC Division.

Its ability to force changes in both the genotype and phenotype of organic beings along with the ease of modifying it for whatever purpose desired made it one of the most important developments in biological warfare on the face of the earth, sought after by various organizations both before and after the bombs.

FEV has appeared or been mentioned in various forms throughout the Fallout series.

It typically serves the role of a superweapon for various antagonists, most prominently utilized by the Master to create super mutants for his army, the Unity, and by separate divisions of the Enclave to enact genocide on the rest of humanity.

Also known as: FEV.
